title: Narrow
statement: Implement `solve(value)`. `value` is a string, or the token `none`. Return `value` when it is a string, including empty. Return the string `missing` when the token is none. Do not call string methods on the missing token.
hints: Compare with the token none first.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Narrowing is the if that proves a value is a string before you treat it as one.

editorial: Narrowing is the if that proves a value is a string before you treat it as one. After the check, the type checker accepts the string methods. This function returns the string or a missing marker and does not need a method call to make the branch real.
